name: bob
description: BOB: designed-first, gated and visible builds for non-technical Steppers. A board pane read from bob/ledger.json, Gate A (no unapproved edit), Gate B (no round ends without evidence), a session preflight, /bob status, /bob adopt (govern an existing repo from a validated proposal, brief written last) and /bob approve (a person's typed approval, the only writer of bob/approvals.json), plus the bob-adopt skill.
